verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental platform, so scheduled or recurring jobs are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no user-facing recurring scheduler. What it does show is one-off lifecycle controls (TTL, end time, spend cap that delete a pod), agent-driven single runs, and an automatic volume backup schedule. That backup schedule is a platform maintenance feature, not user-scheduled workflows, so none of these count as recurring job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
